description: This file contains implementation of a function 'rebase_parse_value' that parses textual configuration values related to rebasing in Git, interpreting strings like 'merges', 'interactive', and 'preserve'. It includes logic to determine the rebase mode based on user-provided strings.

methods.name: enum:rebase_type rebase_parse_value(const char * value)
methods.description: Parses the string input for rebase options and returns corresponding enum values indicating rebase mode.
